title: Cope With
subtitle: 「應付／處理／捱過／適應」，關鍵不是事情有沒有完全解決，而是人在困難、壓力或變化中能否繼續運作。
description: 「應付／處理／捱過／適應」，關鍵不是事情有沒有完全解決，而是人在困難、壓力或變化中能否繼續運作。

words.example: She is learning to manage the pressure of her new role.
words.exampleZh: 她正學習應付新職位帶來的壓力。

exercises.original: She is learning to cope with the pressure of her new role.
exercises.zh: 她正學習應付新職位帶來的壓力。
exercises.upgrade: She is learning to manage the pressure of her new role.

options.explanation: pressure 是持續存在的負荷，manage 表示設法應付而不必消除它。
壓力不是一條可一次解決的題目；原句也沒說壓力會消失。
忽視壓力不等於實際應付。
她已身處新職位，不能單靠避開來表達 cope。
fix 更像修正故障／根本問題，不適合一般壓力。
manage 不要求完全掌控，這個選項過強。

exercises.original: He can cope with a heavy workload most weeks.
exercises.zh: 他大部分星期都能應付繁重工作量。
exercises.upgrade: He can manage a heavy workload most weeks.

options.explanation: workload 是持續需要安排和完成的工作，manage 很自然。
避開工作量並非應付。
忽略工作通常會令問題更嚴重。
workload 不是單一待解問題。
只表示撐過，不如 manage 表達正常運作能力。
不適合工作量。

exercises.original: The team struggled to cope with the sudden increase in demand.
exercises.zh: 團隊難以應付需求突然增加。
exercises.upgrade: The team struggled to manage the sudden increase in demand.

options.explanation: sudden increase in demand 需要資源安排和持續處理。
需求仍會存在，忽視不是應付。
團隊不能把既有需求簡單避開。
demand increase 未必能被『解決』，只能設法管理。
接受需求增加不代表有能力處理。
不自然。

words.example: He handled the difficult situation calmly.
words.exampleZh: 他冷靜地處理了這個困難局面。

exercises.original: He coped with the difficult situation calmly.
exercises.zh: 他冷靜地處理了困難局面。
exercises.upgrade: He handled the difficult situation calmly.

options.explanation: calmly + difficult situation 強調實際處理能力，handle 很貼切。
不理會不是處理。
原句表示他已身處局面並作出應對。
未說局面被完全解決，且 automatically 加入不存在意思。
只表示捱過，沒有『冷靜處理』的能力意味。
接受局面不等於處理局面。

exercises.original: Can you cope with customer complaints on your own?
exercises.zh: 你能獨自處理顧客投訴嗎？
exercises.upgrade: Can you handle customer complaints on your own?

options.explanation: complaints 是典型 handle 的工作對象。
職責要求面對投訴。
會構成沒有處理投訴。
投訴不是單純『捱過』的時段。
接受投訴存在不等於回應客戶。
並非每宗投訴都能完全解決，且語義過強。

exercises.original: She copes well with criticism from senior colleagues.
exercises.zh: 她能很好地應對資深同事的批評。
exercises.upgrade: She handles criticism from senior colleagues well.

options.explanation: criticism 是常見 handle 對象，表示成熟應對。
忽視批評可能是一種反應，但不等於 cope well。
無法表達面對批評時的反應。
criticism 不是待解問題。
不能控制別人的批評。
不自然。

words.example: Support from friends helped her get through a difficult year.
words.exampleZh: 朋友的支持幫助她捱過艱難的一年。

exercises.original: Friends helped her cope with a very difficult year.
exercises.zh: 朋友幫助她捱過非常艱難的一年。
exercises.upgrade: Friends helped her get through a very difficult year.

options.explanation: a difficult year 是一段需要熬過去的時期。
一整年不是可一次解決的問題。
不能靠不理會來表達捱過難關。
這段時間已發生，無法避開。
不一定能控制整個人生處境。
不自然。

exercises.original: He used savings to cope with the first few months without work.
exercises.zh: 他用積蓄捱過最初幾個失業月份。
exercises.upgrade: He used savings to get through the first few months without work.

options.explanation: first few months 是明確時間段，表示靠資源捱過。
無法避開已經失業的月份。
經濟需要仍存在。
積蓄未必解決失業根源。
不自然。
接受失業不會支付生活費。

exercises.original: The family is finding ways to cope with a difficult winter.
exercises.zh: 這個家庭正找方法捱過艱難冬天。
exercises.upgrade: The family is finding ways to get through a difficult winter.

options.explanation: difficult winter 是一段外在艱難時期，最自然是熬過。
冬天本身不能解決。
不符。
除非搬走，否則原句沒有這層意思。
無法完全控制外在季節條件。
不符。

words.example: The team must deal with several unexpected problems.
words.exampleZh: 團隊必須處理數個突發問題。

exercises.original: The team must cope with several unexpected problems.
exercises.zh: 團隊必須處理數個突發問題。
exercises.upgrade: The team must deal with several unexpected problems.

options.explanation: unexpected problems 需要採取行動處理，最自然。
不處理問題。
問題已出現。
接受存在不等於處理。
只表示撐住，沒有問題處理意味。
有些問題只能管理，未必全部修好。

exercises.original: Managers need to cope with complaints quickly and fairly.
exercises.zh: 經理需要迅速而公平地處理投訴。
exercises.upgrade: Managers need to deal with complaints quickly and fairly.

options.explanation: quickly and fairly 是投訴處理程序的自然搭配。
投訴不能被職責上避開。
與公平處理相反。
不符行政處理語境。
不能等同處理每宗投訴。
接收投訴不等於處理。

exercises.original: The policy explains how staff should cope with conflicts of interest.
exercises.zh: 政策解釋員工應如何處理利益衝突。
exercises.upgrade: The policy explains how staff should deal with conflicts of interest.

options.explanation: conflicts of interest 是正式政策中常見 deal with 對象。
利益衝突不能不理。
有些衝突需要披露／管理，不能假定完全避免。
不一定可以『解決』所有利益衝突。
不自然。
不符。

words.example: Small businesses are facing rising costs.
words.exampleZh: 小型企業正面對不斷上升的成本。

exercises.original: Small businesses must cope with rising costs.
exercises.zh: 小型企業必須面對不斷上升的成本。
exercises.upgrade: Small businesses must face rising costs.

options.explanation: rising costs 是外在挑戰，face 表示企業必須面對它。
成本上升未必可由單一企業解決。
不會令成本消失。
可能無法完全避開。
過於機械。
企業未必能掌控市場成本。

exercises.original: Students often have to cope with uncertainty when choosing a career.
exercises.zh: 學生選擇職業時常要面對不確定性。
exercises.upgrade: Students often have to face uncertainty when choosing a career.

options.explanation: uncertainty 是必須面對的狀態。
不確定性不是一條可完全解決的問題。
職涯選擇本身常包含不確定性。
不等於成熟應對。
不自然。

exercises.original: The organisation is coping with serious financial difficulties.
exercises.zh: 機構正面對嚴重財政困難。
exercises.upgrade: The organisation is facing serious financial difficulties.

options.explanation: financial difficulties 是外在困難，be facing 很自然。
和積極應對意思不同。
困難已存在。
可處理某些問題，但 financial difficulties 不一定能直接『修好』。
加入不存在的自動解決意味。
過強。

words.example: Employees had to adapt to the new working arrangements.
words.exampleZh: 員工必須適應新的工作安排。

exercises.original: Employees had to cope with the new working arrangements.
exercises.zh: 員工必須適應新的工作安排。
exercises.upgrade: Employees had to adapt to the new working arrangements.

options.explanation: new arrangements 要求員工調整習慣和做法。
不理新安排會妨礙工作。
新制度可能無法避開。
安排本身不是問題。

exercises.original: The business learned to cope with rapid technological change.

exercises.upgrade: The business learned to adapt to rapid technological change.

options.explanation: technological change 要求改變方法／系統，是典型 adapt to。

不符。
科技轉變通常不能完全避開。
科技不是故障。
企業未必能控制整個市場變化。

exercises.original: Children often cope with a new school by changing their routines gradually.
exercises.zh: 兒童常透過逐步改變日常習慣來適應新學校。
exercises.upgrade: Children often adapt to a new school by changing their routines gradually.

options.explanation: changing routines 是適應新環境的直接線索。
新學校不是待解問題。
不符。
不符。
不符。
不能掌控整個新學校環境。

words.example: The organisation responded quickly to the sudden increase in demand.
words.exampleZh: 機構迅速應對需求突然增加。

exercises.original: The hospital had to cope with a sudden rise in patient numbers.
exercises.zh: 醫院必須應對病人數目突然增加。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital had to respond to a sudden rise in patient numbers.

options.explanation: sudden rise 需要即時採取應對措施。
病人仍需要服務。
醫院不能把病人需求避開。
人數上升未必是可完全解決的問題。
不自然。
接受情況不代表採取行動。

exercises.original: The government must cope with changing public expectations.

exercises.upgrade: The government must respond to changing public expectations.

options.explanation: public expectations change 時，政策／溝通需要作出回應。
不是應對。
無法避免社會期望。
太被動且不符政策行動。
期望不是故障。
政府不能完全控制公眾期望。

exercises.original: Schools are finding new ways to cope with increased demand for support.
exercises.zh: 學校正找新方法應對支援需求增加。

options.explanation: demand for support 需要服務上的實際回應。
需求已存在。
不符。
需求未必能永久消失。
不自然。

words.example: The council is tackling the housing shortage.
words.exampleZh: 議會正著手處理房屋短缺問題。

exercises.zh: 議會正著手處理房屋短缺。
exercises.upgrade: The council is trying to tackle the housing shortage.

options.explanation: housing shortage 是需要積極政策介入的難題。
不符。
地方政府不能簡單避開問題。
接受短缺存在不等於處理。
不符政策語境。

exercises.original: The team is coping with a large backlog of cases.
exercises.zh: 團隊正著手處理大量積壓個案。

options.explanation: backlog 是一項需要主動清理的工作難題。
會令積壓更嚴重。
不符。
不等於處理。
不自然。

exercises.original: The programme helps communities cope with long-term inequality.

exercises.upgrade: The programme helps communities tackle long-term inequality.

options.explanation: inequality 是需要持續主動應對的社會問題。

exercises.original: He is still coping with the loss of his job.

falseSynonyms.zh: 解決不等於 cope with solve 表示把問題解決；cope with 可以只是在問題仍存在時設法應付。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can cope with a problem without solving it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忽視不是應付 ignore 是不理會；cope with 表示實際面對並設法處理／承受。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ignoring a difficulty is not the same as coping with it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 避開不等於 cope with avoid 表示不接觸或避開問題；cope with 表示問題存在時仍要應付。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Avoiding prevents contact; coping deals with the situation when it exists.

falseSynonyms.zh: 接受不等於所有 cope with accept 可是應對的一部分，尤其不可改變的現實，但不表示完整管理能力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Acceptance can support coping, but the two are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 生存／捱過不等於所有 cope with survive 只表示沒有被擊倒或死亡；cope with 還包括日常管理、調節和功能維持。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Survival is an outcome; coping is a process.

falseSynonyms.zh: 控制不等於 cope with control 表示掌控情況；很多事情即使不能控制，人仍可 cope with。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON control is stronger: people often cope with situations they cannot control.

falseSynonyms.zh: 修好不等於 cope with fix 偏把故障／問題修正；cope with 可以是暫時應付而沒有修好根源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fixing removes or repairs a problem; coping manages its effects.

falseSynonyms.zh: 注意介詞 標準用法是 cope with something；一般不說 cope something。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cope normally takes with before its object: cope with stress.
